name: Santa Rosa
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Santa Rosa for 2026, and here is what he found: 24 family events across Santa Rosa and Healdsburg, 11 of them free. The magic runs from November 19 (Northern Lights Winter Lights Art Walk) through January 18, 2027, with the Historic Railroad Square Horse and Carriage Rides (December 5 to 24), the free Merry and Bright skating shows at Snoopy's Home Ice (December 4 to 6) and A Magical Cirque Christmas (December 18) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Santa Rosa

  • 24 Christmas events for kids in Santa Rosa and Healdsburg
  • 11 free events, including the Winter Lights Tree Lighting Celebration, the Railroad Square Horse and Carriage Rides, the Northern Lights Winter Lights Art Walk, the Merry and Bright skating shows and the Merry Healdsburg Tree Lighting
  • Meet Santa: Weekend Santa Sightings at Montgomery Village (November 28 to December 20) and Breakfast with Santa at Costeaux French Bakery in Healdsburg (November 28 to December 19)
  • Lights and tree lightings: the Winter Lights Tree Lighting Celebration, the Montgomery Village tree lighting, Merry Healdsburg and the Northern Lights art walk (November 19 to January 18)
  • Shows: Merry and Bright (December 4 to 6), A Very Merry Ice Show (December 11 and 12) and A Magical Cirque Christmas (December 18)
  • Season: November 19 to January 18, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Santa Rosa families also use our guides to Christmas activities for kids in Napa and Rohnert Park, which cover Silverado's Santa train rides and the Spreckels Nutcracker productions.
